scrapfly.note: Official Scrapfly hosted MCP server. Uses OAuth2 — on first connection the agent is prompted to authorize via browser; tokens are stored and refreshed locally. API-key alternatives (Authorization: Bearer header, or ?key= query parameter) are documented at https://scrapfly.io/docs/mcp/authentication. Tools: web_scrape, screenshot, check_if_blocked, the Cloud Browser session lifecycle, and WebMCP discovery.
